reasoning_summary: The bug report and failing test indicate that the CSV parser fails to increment the line number when encountering a carriage return (CR) as a line separator. The test expects the line number to increment after reading a record terminated by '\r', but the parser remains at 0. This confirms that the internal line counter logic is not correctly identifying or processing CR as a valid line terminator, leading to an off-by-one error in line tracking.
